reason: Version 3 keeps nearly every fact and nuance (fear as a practical problem, not a flaw; surprise at not minding; oddly restful; the room metaphor) in my own register. Its only loss is the 'not triumphant' contrast, which 'quietly astonished' largely carries. Version 1 adds a casual 'sure' and 'a lot of' and drops the surprise, Version 2 cuts the character-flaw point, and Version 4 changes facts and drops the ending image.
